title: RENOVI: A Benchmark Towards Remediating Norm Violations in Socio-Cultural Conversations
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focused on remediating socio-cultural norm violations in Chinese conversations.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as its focus is on general socio-cultural norms in a Chinese context, such as politeness in requests, apologies, and greetings.
